description: This file contains controller functions for managing doctor-related operations in a backend API, including login, appointment management, profile handling, and dashboard data.

methods.name: loginDoctor
methods.description: Handles doctor login by verifying credentials and issuing a JWT token.

methods.name: appointmentsDoctor
methods.description: Retrieves all appointments for a specific doctor.

methods.name: appointmentCancel
methods.description: Cancels a specific appointment if the doctor ID matches.

methods.name: appointmentComplete
methods.description: Marks an appointment as completed if the doctor ID matches.

methods.name: doctorList
methods.description: Fetches a list of all doctors excluding sensitive information.

methods.name: changeAvailablity
methods.description: Toggles the availability status of a doctor.

methods.name: doctorProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the profile data of a specific doctor.

methods.name: updateDoctorProfile
methods.description: Updates profile details of a specific doctor.

methods.name: doctorDashboard
methods.description: Provides dashboard metrics such as earnings, appointments count, and patients list for a doctor.
